summary: Frontend-only verification for logo/authority-strip/hero-slider changes on Dubai Vize Online. All 6 test items PASS. Brand logo (/brand/logo-horizontal.png, 714x200) loads intact on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844); no cropping. Authority strip contains exactly 2 cards in correct order — authority-item-tursab FIRST, authority-item-gdrfa SECOND, with zero occurrences of 'ICP', 'Federal Authority for Identity', 'Federal kimlik' or 'vatandaşlık otoritesi'. /brand/tursab.png loads (1674x683). Hero slider auto-advances (caption changed Çöl safari → Business Bay after ~6.5s) and dot navigation works (dot-3 → 'Çöl safari · Al Marmoom'). Regression pages /vize-tipleri, /gerekli-belgeler, /iletisim, /basvuru render with brand logo intact, no console errors. Footer uses the same horizontal logo (light variant via BrandMark). Admin login with admin@vizeatlas.com / Dubai2026! succeeds and admin sidebar renders the brand logo.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/content/site occasionally logged as requestfailed in browser (network events); page still renders correctly with default company data, so likely a transient/CORS-preflight artifact behind ingress. Worth a quick backend check but non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: HeroSlider prev/next buttons are opacity-0 until group-hover — on touch devices they are effectively invisible until tapped. Consider showing them at reduced opacity on small screens for discoverability.
Slider auto-advance interval is 4500ms while the request statement says ~6s; not a bug but expectation-vs-doc mismatch.
